study: Replogle et al. 2022, K562/RPE1; independent of primary-T GWT experiment, strongly shifted cell backgrounds
purpose: Recheck saved held-study outputs and add predefined readouts, positive/negative controls before writing; not a new pristine confirmatory test
selection: Only original GWT selection donor; no external training or selection; no new fitting
positive: guide-disjoint halves when at least two distinct guide assignments available, all control guide assignments split alternately; >=5 cells each target half and control half
uncertainty: 2000 paired target-cluster bootstrap draws, descriptive conditional on these targets; not donor replication
source_retention: All 6795 shared published retained genes; no outcome-based external gene selection; this is not raw realignment or all-genome coverage
prior_test_exposure: Original MAE and other existing outputs already examined; additional analyses are exploratory
